scientific_integrity: The symbolic proof uses a published necessary-condition lemma and exhausts its 21 admissible integer pairs with exact rational arithmetic. The verifier is supplementary, not an infinite proof. The three-way tie occurs at \(a=60\). Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to two-term underapproximations on the full real interval \(1/4,1/3]\). It does not classify intervals with other first denominators or underapproximations with three or more terms.
title: Exact two-term Egyptian underapproximation classification for the first-denominator-four interval
